title: Who edits organisation settings, Track3D or the customer
question: Should organisation and regional admins edit their own organisation profile, integrations, project-creation rules and data-export settings, or do these stay with Track3D support? Which fields stay locked (for example the contact email)?
context: The org-settings PRD gives these sections to organisation and regional admins and leaves per-section roles open. Today company updates and the enterprise flag are support-only, and the update accepts any field (ENT-REQ-005, ENT-REQ-008).
options: Customer organisation admins manage all sections; Track3D keeps the enterprise flag
Customer admins manage the profile only; Track3D manages the rest
